description.value:
Traits Signal

You gain access to Encore Performance at 14th level, and you may use it twice per day rather than once. The second use each day always carries some distortion — the GM decides what comes back changed, and it is never nothing. If the Requiem Frequency is not yours, you can still use Encore Performance, but only while broadcasting.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 (Encore Performance is the `requiem-track` 15th-level ability, itself SB1/SB4-blocked) — this card only ever modifies an ability that doesn't exist as encoded content. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either. All three Frequency-track base auras (Numbers, Open Band, Requiem, and their action-card twins) ship "rules": [] despite describing at-will auras with real numbers. Buildable in principle via Aura + a companion effect (same shape as SB3), unbuildable in practice because no such companion item exists, and because the base aura's own radius/uptime is itself gated on the un-encoded Broadcast (SB3).
